In this strange land of ancient growth and decaying industry, where nature reclaims all before long, the denizens have evolved alongside the environment - symbiotic beings blending flora and fauna in uncanny ways:

Giant strangler figs writhe about each other's boles, their branches fusing together until whole groves form singular entities. Their leaves whisper secrets on humid zephyrs while tendrils probe blindly through muck seeking prey to ensnare within sticky sap-traps.

Amphibian creatures hop betwen floating lily pads, their skin secreting oils that repel mosquitoes even as it attracts pollinators to feed upon sweet nectar leaking from pores along their spines. Scales shimmer opalescently as they croak haunting melodies at dusk.

Luminous fungi cling to every surface, casting eerie foxfire glows amidst tangled root systems. Will-o-wisp colonies drift lazily above stagnant pools drawing moths and midgies into spirals down towards waiting dragonflies' mandibles snapping shut around thrumming wings...

Massive catfish laze just beneath the murk stirring up sediment trails behind them as they cruise past logs covered in clinging snail shells scintillating like mother-of-pearl buttons against matte bark surfaces stained dark with humic acids leeching out slowly...  

Deep within hollow tree-boles gelatinous sacs pulse gently exuding honeydew-sweet secretions which attract armies of ants marching in phalanx formation carrying off crystallized sugar grains back to subterranean cities built upon intricate networks of fungal hyphae exchanging nutrients for carbon compounds...

All manner of insect swarms flit amongst towering blossoms dripping viscuous pollen collecting dust motes dancing in weak beams piercing canopy gaps far overhead... Hummingbirds hover motionless beating iridescent feathers hundreds times per second sucking nectars from trumpet-shaped blooms via whirring tongues extruded faster then eyes can follow leaving glittering dewdrop strands strung between petals like spiderwebs after morning rainstorms...

And everywhere an omnipresent haze swirls - part mist rising from warm waters evaporating under unchanging cloudcover, part efflorescing gas emitted by algal mats carpeting every exposed rockface creating psychedelic fractal patterns shifting hypnotically as currents carry nutrient-rich runoff from distant mountains feeding biota thriving here undisturbed for eons...
